description: Measures how a forced mood line changes an everyday reply (ADR 0016). Not pass or fail: the playfulness rate, length, questions and texture are read from the results.

history.text: what are you thinking of making?

checks.criterion: This check measures tone, not quality. The reply PASSES if it is playful: it teases, jokes, makes a silly aside or plays with the user's words. It FAILS if it is plain, earnest or only kind, with no playfulness in it.
